text: You, being a fan of potatoes, will surely enjoy Linda's Chunky Garlic Mashed Potatoes. This recipe meets your dietary requirement of being gluten-free, and it's also quick to prepare, fitting within your 60-minute time budget. The dish is rich and flavorful, with roasted garlic adding a depth of taste. While it's not particularly low in calories, it's a satisfying option for a short amount of time.
